_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8VsCYkn9rw8Z1i5vq5MHxL4)_
Refs #26572 (slice 1 of about 3: items declarative-endpoint-execution, second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields, data-request-shape-and-query-arity, meta-read-doors-v18, error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 api-backend 清单里 5 个被 18.2.0 Tier 1 扫描判为 PARTIAL 的条目补上 HTTP 层（真实 Hono 栈）的 dogfood 钉子，并把这 5 条的 automated.ref、verify 文本、revision 和 history 更新。
- 为什么改：这些条款的判据在 HTTP 或构建层，旧钉子只到单元/引擎层，每次发版扫描都要人工再跑活腿；现在变成常驻、可重跑的证明。
- 风险与回滚：只加测试和清单文本，不改任何产品代码；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。dogfood 只在 main 的定时/推送批次跑，不进 PR 和合并队列。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/declarative-endpoint-authoring-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`（子进程跑 CLI）、`packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/second-object-exposure-fixture.ts`（共享 fixture 加了一个 internal 字段）、`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/api-backend.json`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/data-request-shape-live.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 13 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Five api-backend checklist items that the release-18.2.0 Tier 1 sweep (#26468) scored PARTIAL now carry pins at the layer their oracle names. Every new case drives a booted stack through `@objectstack/verify`'s real HTTP surface (Hono request injection), or the CLI's own `bin/run.js` as a child process for the one `build` oracle.

| Item | Clauses pinned | Pin |
|---|---|---|
| `api-backend.declarative-endpoint-execution` | acceptance[1] (401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` code), acceptance[2] (`os validate` / `os build` refuse a script and a proxy endpoint, naming it, the type and the flow prescription, no artifact; the #5488 withdrawal: `PUT /meta/api/NAME` answers 403 `NOT_CREATABLE`) | `showcase-declarative-endpoints.dogfood.test.ts` (extended), `declarative-endpoint-authoring-refusal.dogfood.test.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.second-object-exposure-and-internal-fields` | acceptance[1] (refusal located at `filter.REL` on both doors), acceptance[3] (an `internal: true` field refused 400 `INVALID_FIELD` naming object and field in filter, sort, groupBy and aggregate positions) | `second-object-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` (extended); its fixture gains `sox_source.internal_f` |
| `api-backend.data-request-shape-and-query-arity` | acceptance[1]–[4] | `data-request-shape-live.dogfood.test.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.meta-read-doors-v18` | acceptance[1]–[4] (the FLS half for a `client_liaison`-bound member, both halves agreeing) | `meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` (new) |
| `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` | acceptance[1]–[3] | `error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts` + `fixtures/error-sentences-fixture.ts` (new scratch app) |

Each item's `automated.ref` names the new pins and what they assert, the verify texts that said "live leg" now say which pin carries the clause, `revision` is bumped and a `history` row cites #26572. No clause text changed. No product code changed.

## Why

The card's ruled scope (triage 6437722483): pin the 11 api-backend Tier 1 clauses the 18.2.0 sweep scored PARTIAL at the layer their oracle names, in `packages/qa/dogfood/**`, with the checklist item revisions bumped, in slices of about five items, with no new CI lane. This is the first slice. The other six items (packaged-action-disabled-dispatch, action-activation-door-contract, rest-crud-config-contract, rest-batch-config-contract, rest-metadata-config-contract, rest-route-generation-tombstones) are left for later slices.

## Tests

All seven touched dogfood files on the final head 19a4d705, under the verify lock, after rebuilding the one package main moved since the base (`driver-sql`):

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/data-request-shape-live.dogfood.test.ts test/meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts test/declarative-endpoint-authoring-refusal.dogfood.test.ts test/second-object-exposure.dogfood.test.ts test/import-reference-exposure.dogfood.test.ts test/showcase-declarative-endpoints.dogfood.test.ts
 Test Files  7 passed (7)
      Tests  119 passed (119)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

`import-reference-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` is in the run because it shares the fixture that gained a field. Every expectation was first measured against the live answer on a probe boot and checked against the clause text before it was written down. No ablation: the diff changes no tested behaviour, only adds pins over behaviour that already holds.

## Acceptance notes

- Dogfood runs only in `main`'s scheduled and push battery (`Dogfood Regression Gate`'s `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`), so the PR's CI does not run these files; the local run above is their evidence until the next `main` battery.
- The CLI pin writes its scratch config through `defineStack(…, { strict: false })` with `@objectstack/spec` linked into a temporary `node_modules`: the commands accept only a stack `defineStack` returned, and the strict factory would refuse the endpoint at import, before the command's own gate.
- The located position of a nested-relation refusal lives only in the refusal sentence (`… at 'filter.REL' …`); the pin asserts that token, the code, the status and `object`.
- The storage fault is forced by putting the local adapter's root under a regular file, so the write fails with `ENOTDIR`; the pin asserts `500 INTERNAL` and that neither the errno, the path nor a stack line reaches the body.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`: exit 0, `OK — 16 areas, 329 items (324 active, 1 planned)`.
- 55 derived commands: 53 exit 0; 2 exit 3 (prerequisite not met, nothing measured): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its positive control is pinned to a commit outside this shallow clone) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (reads built output of packages outside the dogfood closure). Both run in CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood run typecheck`: exit 0.
- eslint over the eight touched TypeScript files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 55 derived families accounted for, 53 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.

</details>

No changeset: `@objectstack/dogfood` is private and `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
